description: This file contains shell script tests for the 'git rev-list --disk-usage' command, including setup of repository states, size calculations, verifying behavior with and without bitmaps, and error handling.

methods.name: disk_usage_slow
methods.description: Calculates the total disk usage of objects in the repository by piping rev-list to cat-file batch-check and summing their sizes.

methods.name: check_du
methods.description: Runs a series of tests to compare the disk usage output of rev-list with and without bitmap indexes for a given set of revision arguments.
